items.title: 68356_Howard R. Scott oral history interview
items.q: She came there, one of the acts. Very difficult to play for, because she'd stop in the middle of the singing

ctx.x: What kind of club was it?

A regular -- a nightclub. And they had a lot of celebrities. Jimmy Durante, the nose, he was one of them. And Evelyn Nesbeth, you don't remember her because she was connected with Harry K. way back there, in that big scandal that time. They had a -- but she was an old-timer. She came there, one of the acts. Very difficult to play for, because she'd stop in the middle of the singing, and see somebody at a table she knew, she'd start talking to them. And then you'd wait til see got through, and then she'd pick up…
Very difficult. But she was very nice, though.
